edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings instead of pydantic and keep the class otherwise unchanged.
Import BaseSettings from pydantic_settings and replace the inner class Config with model_config = SettingsConfigDict(...), keeping env_prefix and other settings.

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.

In both `validate_namespaces` and `validate_resources`, return the literal `"*"` unchanged before iterating the value. As written, the namespace validator turns `"*"` into `["*"]`, while the resource validator tries to look up `"*"` as a resource kind; preserve wildcard semantics under Pydantic v2.

Make `validate_prometheus_other_headers` accept `None` and return `{}` for it before handling dicts or lists. The CLI passes `None` when `--prometheus-headers` is omitted, so the `mode="before"` validator should normalize that input rather than iterating it.

Make `_Settings` a plain proxy class instead of subclassing `Config`/`BaseSettings`. Its inherited Pydantic fields can shadow delegation to `_config`; keeping only `__getattr__` delegation ensures reads such as `settings.resources` and `settings.quiet` come from the configured instance.

In `__list_hpa_v1`, remove the `run_in_executor` wrapper around the async `_list_namespaced_or_global_objects` call and await that coroutine directly. It currently returns a coroutine as `res`, which is then consumed with `async for`; instead iterate the awaited list when building the HPA mapping.
